artifact_role: durable derived signal transitions and axis-audit evidence for Phase A/B asset-allocation research

source.description: operator-supplied TradingView Pine log from Macro Pressure Map V6.6 parity capture used in Issue #59
source.duplicate_date_policy: Duplicate rows are accepted only when tv_plot_gpi/tv_plot_ipi/tv_plot_fcpi are identical; then keep the last identical row.

derivation.first_source_row_excluded_reason: The raw axis cannot be uniquely recovered from the first logged EMA observation without the preceding EMA state.

cross_check.description: Independent reconstruction from the logged V6.6 source inputs using the merged Python-mirror formulas after its local warm-up becomes finite.
cross_check.interpretation: Differences are rounding noise from decimal precision in the TradingView log.
cross_check.reproduction_requirement: Supply the operator-local Pine log whose SHA-256 matches the frozen source hash. The script independently recomputes V6.6 from logged source inputs and fails if any raw-axis maximum absolute discrepancy exceeds 5e-8.

axis_audit_csv.sampling: Deterministic audit checkpoints: derived raw rows at zero-based positions 0, 100, 200, ... plus the final row. Values are stored to 8 decimal places.
axis_audit_csv.purpose: Preserve inspectable raw GPI/IPI/FCPI checkpoints, including FCPI context, without committing the operator-local Pine log or claiming the sample is a substitute for the full local derivation.

transition_csv.mapping_semantics: Assign each outcome trading date to the latest transition start_date at or before that date. The outcome calendar includes SPY, the same anchor market used by the Pine log.

evidence_boundary: This is reused Issue #59 TradingView evidence, not newly untouched OOS data. V6.6 production parameters are unchanged. The committed audit checkpoints make the recovered axes inspectable; the full daily reconstruction remains reproducible from the hash-frozen operator-local log.
